{{Recipe}}

'''Sardine bread''' is a yeasted bread containing tinned sardines. It is delicious accompanied by fruit juice.

== Ingredients ==
* 5 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* ½ cup + 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] warm water
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] white [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* 3 tsp active dry [[Cookbook:Yeast|yeast]]
* 250 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] lukewarm [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* Sardine oil
* Tinned [[Cookbook:Sardine|sardines]]

== Procedure ==
# [[Cookbook:Sifting|Sift]] the flour into a clean bowl. Add salt to taste, and mix everything together.
# In another separate clean bowl, combine the warm water, sugar, yeast, and milk.
# Transfer the flour mix into the yeast mix. Stir in the sardine oil, and mix it all together to make a [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]].
# Transfer the dough to a clean work surface, and [[Cookbook:Kneading|knead]] it well.
# Rub some soya oil in a clean bowl. Place the dough in the greased bowl, and turn it to make sure the oil coats the dough. Cover the dough, and [[Cookbook:Proofing|proof]] for at least an hour until it doubles in volume.
# Press on the dough to deflate it. Knead again, and [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|roll it out]].
# Place the sardines one at a time inside the dough, and roll it up to enclose the sardines.
# Line a [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]] with [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment paper]]. Place the dough inside the baking pan and proof for at least another 20 minutes.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 45 minutes.
# Cool before cutting and serving.
